data.one_liner: WidgetFactory extension to render SVG inside HTML widgets via flutter_svg.
data.what_it_does: Extends flutter_widget_from_html_core to render SVG images using the flutter_svg plugin. It enables custom factory configuration such as allowing drawing outside the view box.
use_when: You are using flutter_widget_from_html_core and need to render SVG elements inside your HTML content.
You want to configure SVG rendering behavior within HTML widgets using a custom WidgetFactory.
weaknesses: Strictly dependent on specific versions of flutter_widget_from_html_core and flutter_svg.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_widget_from_html_core and fwfh_svg to dependencies, then use SvgFactory in your custom WidgetFactory.
